name: hopboard
description: Live clipboard sharing. Static frontend, no build step — this file exists so Node treats src/*.js as ES modules when running tests. Nothing here is needed to deploy.

scripts.verify: node tests/static-check.mjs && node tests/lock.mjs && node tests/dialog.mjs && node tests/whatsnew.mjs && node tests/files.mjs
scripts.test: npm run verify && node tests/e2e.mjs && node tests/boot.mjs && node tests/boot.mjs --locked && node tests/fallback.mjs

comment: jsdom is only needed by tests/boot.mjs, which skips cleanly when it is absent. tests/fallback.mjs needs a relay on 127.0.0.1:8000 and skips cleanly without one. The app itself has zero dependencies and ships as-is.
